tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Quotation for 3D GIS Survey and Integration for Property Tax and Utility Asset Management Using Mobile LiDAR, DGPS, UAV/Drone Based Lidar with Oblique Camera with Nadir and Geospatial Technologies Ballari City Corporation

itemList.description: Collect field data for the property tax map using Mobile LiDAR, DGPS, UAV/Drone Based Lidar with Oblique Camera with Nadir, Geospatial Technologies and door-to-door surveys. Prepare a GIS-based base map with a spatial database, integrating available MIS secondary data of Ballari city.

Develop a GIS-based web and mobile application for Ballari City Corporation to manage property tax maps and MIS data. The app will allow visualization of spatial and attribute data, enabling efficient queries and spatial analysis.
Provide training, handover, and documentation including user manuals, technical guides, operational workflows of web and mobile applications for Ballari City Corporation officials.

Supply and install workstation 1No and Nas server 50 TB with web applications for property tax management, including deployment and configuration of software for efficient property tax collection, monitoring, and administration through web and mobile platforms.
